title: Condition Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Symptom logs (`condition:symptom`), medication doses (`medication:dose`), vitals readings (`vitals:reading`), flare-up events (`flareup:event`), lab results (`labresult:value`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management — symptom and medication trackers (Bearable, MyTherapy), connected blood-pressure cuffs and glucometers, and lab-result portals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=condition:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for condition metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag condition metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you whether your condition metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
